breakdown.title: The Fish Said My Name
breakdown.logline: At a crowded night market, a fish calls the dreamer by name and is carried through warm rain over a dark iron bridge.

colours.value: warm yellow market lights, darkness beyond the bridge

light.value: strings of little yellow lights, shadow on the bridge, glow from behind

breakdown.world_logic: A fish can speak the dreamer's name, and only the dreamer hears it.

identity.value: night market crowd, hundreds of people

geography.value: outdoor market with stalls, very crowded

landmarks.value: stalls, strings of little yellow lights overhead, fish laid out on ice

geography.value: narrow iron bridge over black water, just enough for the bike

landmarks.value: iron structure, black water below, market lights behind

light.value: mostly shadow, light from behind from the market

appearance.value: silver, about as long as the dreamer's arm
one bicycle, dreamer's sister pedalling, dreamer on the back

moments.action: The dreamer and their older sister stand in a crowded night market under strings of little yellow lights, surrounded by hundreds of people.
moments.looks_at: the stalls and crowd under yellow lights

moments.action: They stop at a stall where an old man has fish laid out on ice. The dreamer's older sister wants to buy fish.
moments.looks_at: the fish stall with the old man
moments.visual_point: the fish on ice at the stall

moments.action: A silver fish about as long as the dreamer's arm looks at the dreamer and says their name. No one else reacts.
moments.feeling: freaked out but not in a bad way
moments.visual_point: the fish speaking, seen from the side, facing the dreamer
moments.dream: the fish says the dreamer's name and only the dreamer hears it

moments.action: The old man wraps the fish in newspaper and gives it to the dreamer.
moments.looks_at: the old man handing over the wrapped fish
moments.visual_point: the fish wrapped in newspaper being given

moments.action: They are on one bicycle, the sister pedalling, the dreamer on the back holding the paper-wrapped fish against their chest.
moments.visual_point: the dreamer holding the fish on the back of the bike

moments.action: It starts raining big warm drops, and the newspaper around the fish begins to soak.
moments.looks_at: the rain falling on them and the fish

moments.action: They ride over a narrow iron bridge above black water, the market lights behind them. The dreamer holds the fish tighter against their chest.
moments.looks_at: the narrow iron bridge over black water
moments.feeling: moving away from light into shadow
moments.visual_point: the bridge and black water below

moments.action: The fish says the dreamer's name again, quietly. The dreamer wakes up.
moments.visual_point: the moment the fish speaks again
moments.dream: the fish speaks the dreamer's name again, unheard by the sister

blocking.front: the far end of the bridge

m4.text: The shot is seen from outside, with a 35mm lens, camera at the height of their eyes, level, about three metres to the side. In the foreground, across the lower half of the picture from the left edge to just right of the middle, is the fish stall, its surface filling from the middle of the picture to the bottom edge. Behind the stall in the left third stands the old man, turned three-quarters toward the camera and looking to the right, his body filling from a third of the way down to near the bottom, partly hidden by the stall. In the right third, the dreamer stands in profile, facing left, holding the newspaper in both hands; the newspaper fills from low down to two-thirds of the way down the picture, and the dreamer's body fills from a third of the way down to the bottom edge. The light comes from above, from strings of little yellow lights overhead, softly illuminating the figures and the stall. Just outside the picture to the left is the fish; just outside to the right are the other market stalls.

Made as: watercolour on rough paper. Every part of the picture is made this way, the same as every other picture of this dream.
It feels like a dream, in every picture: edges a little too soft to hold.
Technique, followed exactly: loose watercolour washes; soft blurred edges; visible paper texture; gentle colour transitions; low contrast.
Colours: cream, tan, brown, dark brown, black, for the light and everything no image above gives a colour to; each person and thing keeps the colours of its image. What the dream itself gives a colour keeps it exactly: grey hair; silver; yellow bulbs overhead; yellow glow from.
Light: Light is diffused and soft, with no harsh shadows. Edges are blended and often bleed into each other, giving a dreamy, fluid quality. The overall mood is gentle and nostalgic, with muted colours and a soft glow.

Everyone and everything looks exactly as in their images above, except for what this moment itself changes and what is still so from earlier.

Nothing from another picture shows through this one: no other place, sky, wall or person is layered or double-exposed into it, whatever the style.

One single picture filling the whole frame. Every surface in it is free of writing, logos and brand badges: signs, pages and screens stay blank.
